highlights.title: Stop duplicate remote meals from being recorded
changes: Duplicate remote meal commands are now rejected and not stored or dosed.
When a newer carb entry exists, the meal command is logged as rejected and handling stops.
Future-dated equivalents or scheduled meals no longer trigger false rejections.
Log messages about rejected commands now match the app's actual behavior.

sources.title: gordolio/Trio#1346: Fix duplicate remote meal being re-stored on replay

highlights.title: EversenseKit update: DMS logging, keychain, thresholds
changes: DMS uploads now include improved logging.
DMS credentials are now stored in the device keychain.
Low glucose threshold can be set from 60 to 115 mg/dL in 1 mg/dL steps.
High glucose threshold can be set from 125 to 350 mg/dL in 1 mg/dL steps.
Rate-change threshold can be set from 1.5 to 5 mg/dL/min in 0.1 mg/dL/min steps.

highlights.title: Prevent pod alert deadlock on startup
changes: App is less likely to freeze during startup when a DASH pod advertises an alert.
Pod alerts advertised before a connection are handled without causing a deadlock.
OmnipodKit submodule was updated to include the fix for this issue.

includedPullRequests.title: Fix duplicate remote meal being re-stored on replay
includedPullRequests.body:
## Summary

The guard in `handleMealCommand` that rejects a remote meal when newer carb entries already exist never actually aborts the handler. Its `return` sits inside a nested `Task {}` inside `taskContext.perform {}`, so it only exits that closure. The handler logs "Command rejected" and then stores the carbs anyway.

This computes the fetch result via `await taskContext.perform { ... }` returning a `Bool` and guards from the handler itself, so the rejection stops storage.

## Background

Noticed while running Trio with LoopFollow remote control for our young daughter. If a meal command is delivered twice (APNs redelivery, or a caregiver resend after an unclear failure), the duplicate carbs are stored and dosed for, while the log claims the command was rejected.

I'm @justmaier on the Trio Discord if it's easier to discuss there.

Fixes #1348

includedPullRequests.title: Bump OmnipodKit to 792dc19
includedPullRequests.body:
Moves the `OmnipodKit` submodule to the current tip of [loopandlearn/OmnipodKit `dev`](https://github.com/loopandlearn/OmnipodKit/tree/dev). Follow-up to #1380.

`e31a8d1` → `792dc19`

### What's included

https://github.com/loopandlearn/OmnipodKit/pull/128:
`4162807` Fix re-entrant `managerQueue` deadlock surfacing a pod alert from an advert

`surfacePodConditionAndQuiet` runs on `managerQueue` (from `centralManager didDiscover`) and called `omnipodDidDetectAlert` inline. The host handles that synchronously via `getPodStatus` → `runSession` → `bleRunSession` → `peripheralManager(forIdentifier:)`, which does `managerQueue.sync` — a sync-to-self deadlock. It fired on a fresh launch when a DASH pod advertised a fault/alert transition before any connection had established `BlePodComms.manager`. The fix dispatches the delegate notification off `managerQueue`; alarm-scan quieting stays on it.
